text_blocks.snippet: For optimal protection against COVID-19, properly fitted respirators like N95 and KN95 masks are recommended. These masks offer the best filtration, capturing at least 95% of airborne particles, including those carrying the virus. While any mask is better than none, N95s and KN95s, when properly fitted, provide the highest level of protection for both the wearer and those around them.
Here's why N95s and KN95s are preferred:

list.title: High Filtration Efficiency:
list.snippet: They are designed to filter out a large percentage of airborne particles, including the virus that causes COVID-19.

list.title: Close Facial Fit:
list.snippet: Their design ensures a tight seal around the nose and mouth, minimizing leakage and maximizing protection.

list.title: Potential for Extended Use:
list.snippet: They can be worn for longer periods and multiple times, unlike some other mask types.

list.title: Protection for Wearer and Others:
list.snippet: When worn by someone with COVID-19, they can significantly reduce the spread of the virus, and they also protect the wearer from inhaling the virus.
